# lvlath/go

> Deterministic, contract-driven pure-Go graph algorithms, dense numerical
> algebra, time-series alignment, statistics, stochastic models, econometrics
> and causal indicators. Import the owning package under `github.com/lvlath/go`.

Repository: https://github.com/lvlath/go. Go 1.23.4 or newer at the reviewed
revision; check `go.mod` for the selected version. License: AGPL-3.0-only.
Use `go get github.com/lvlath/go@latest`, then consult documentation at the
actual module version. A published GoDoc version may lag main. This index is
supplementary; source and package contracts remain authoritative.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/README.md): package map and examples.
- [Module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/go.mod): actual import path and Go version.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/README.md): guide discovery and import boundaries.
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md): mathematical objects and data composition.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/FAQ_%26_TIPS.md): practical failure diagnosis.
- [UES](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/lvlath_UES.md): engineering standard.
- [AGENTS](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/AGENTS.md): operational change rules.
- [Go reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go): selected-version public API.

## Package-selection guide

The 41 packages are grouped by objective. A family is not an import hierarchy.

### A. Topology, paths, capacity and discrete optimization (11)

- [core](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/core): Deterministic capability-driven graph topology, stable IDs and traversal surfaces.
- [builder](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/builder): Deterministic graph constructors and numeric datasets for experiments.
- [gridgraph](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/gridgraph): Rectangular lattice connectivity, island analysis, 0-1 expansion and conversion to core.Graph.
- [bfs](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/bfs): Unweighted shortest-hop traversal, deterministic paths and weak components.
- [dfs](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/dfs): Depth-first forest, finish order, cycle witnesses and topological sort.
- [dijkstra](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/dijkstra): Full SSSP and four target methods: Dijkstra, bidirectional, consistent A*, balanced bidirectional A*.
- [mst](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/mst): Prim/Kruskal MST/MSF, KMB graph Steiner approximation, closed or fixed-end tree-covering walks.
- [flow](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/flow): Canonical MaxFlow (Dinic, Edmonds-Karp, Ford-Fulkerson) with MaxFlowResult residual, cut and interruption evidence.
- [matrix](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/matrix): Row-major dense algebra, graph adapters, APSP, stable statistics, pivoted solves and direct economy SVD.
- [match](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/match): Minimum-weight perfect matching on an ordered even matrix subset; exact-or-error Blossom and explicit Greedy.
- [tsp](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/tsp): Matrix-backed TSP/ATSP, exact Held-Karp and completed Branch-and-Bound, Christofides and local search.

### B. Time, features and alignment (7)

- [series](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/series): Exact integer-nanosecond grids, causal lag/difference/returns, complete index windows.
- [acf](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/acf): Direct fixed-window sample autocorrelation with common or lag-adjusted denominator and pair counts.
- [pacf](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/pacf): Common-n Durbin-Levinson partial autocorrelation and order-wise prediction-error variance.
- [paa](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/paa): Fractional equal-duration compression with exact rational segment geometry and correctly rounded means.
- [sax](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/sax): Immutable symbolic encoders over fractional PAA, explicit normalization and compatible Euclidean MINDIST.
- [dtw](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/dtw): Scalar, cost-matrix and multivariate alignment; bounded classifications and exact fixed-length squared-scalar top-K search.
- [tfsax](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/tfsax): Research-only exact absolute-cost DTW oracle versus classical SAX TopM retrieval.

### C. Statistics, regression, hidden states and inference (6)

- [stats](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/stats): Stable scalar moments, Chan merges, immutable fitted column standardization.
- [ols](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/ols): Full-rank least squares by column-pivoted QR, physical-unit coefficients and frozen prediction.
- [ridge](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/ridge): Positive-Lambda L2 regression via protected augmented pivoted QR, including wide/collinear designs.
- [pca](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/pca): Immutable training covariance eigenbasis, projection and reconstruction in original units.
- [hmm](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/hmm): Categorical and diagonal-Gaussian hidden Markov models, filtering, smoothing, Viterbi and multi-sequence MAP-EM.
- [lstm](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/lstm): Frozen single-layer unidirectional PyTorch IFGO recurrent inference over masked batch-first tensors.

### D. Stochastic computation and econometrics (7)

- [rng](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/rng): Version-pinned SHA-256/PCG-DXSM logical-path streams, open uniforms and cached normals.
- [bootstrap](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/bootstrap): Moving, Circular and Stationary dependent-data block-index ensembles.
- [montecarlo](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/montecarlo): Bounded-parallel independent vector sampling with ordered moments and optional exact empirical quantiles.
- [gbm](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/gbm): Exact-in-distribution lognormal endpoint paths on explicit elapsed-time grids.
- [jumpdiffusion](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/jumpdiffusion): Experimental Merton compound-Poisson lognormal jumps on GBM grids.
- [gjrgarch](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/gjrgarch): Stationary asymmetric GJR-GARCH(1,1), causal variance, expected-variance forecasts and Gaussian QMLE.
- [arima](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/arima): Fixed nonseasonal conditional Gaussian ARIMA with anchored level forecasts and marginal innovation variance.

### E. Indicators: readiness, arithmetic and recovery (10)

- [ema](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/ema): Exact affine exponential levels with explicit SMA or First seed and recoverable streams.
- [atr](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/atr): Exact signed-candle True Range and Wilder ATR with independent readiness and replay.
- [donchian](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/donchian): Observed rolling high/low channels with explicit current-bar policy and exact midpoint.
- [vwap](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/vwap): Exact anchored price-volume means with positive-weight readiness and transactional reset.
- [sessionlevels](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/sessionlevels): Previous completed session high, low and final close over explicit partitions; batch-only.
- [rsi](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/rsi): Wilder gain/loss oscillator over ordered finite positive prices, batch and checkpointable stream.
- [macd](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/macd): SMA-seeded fast/slow Appel EMAs, signed Line/Signal/Histogram and separate masks.
- [mfi](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/mfi): Rolling volume-weighted typical-price flow over P transitions, compensated sums.
- [obv](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/obv): Cumulative signed current-candle base volume with compensated accumulation.
- [ad](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/lvlath/go/ad): Chaikin close-location-weighted current-candle base volume with compensated accumulation.

## Critical semantic boundaries

- Match the mathematical objective and explicit options, not just the package name; never invent a symbol, result field or fallback. Use errors.Is and inspect error before readiness, completion or convergence. Unknown/unreachable/disabled/invalid states are distinct.
- Preserve deterministic ordering and tie decisions, finite domain, true overflow, aliasing and detached-result contracts. Graph storage locking is not algorithm snapshot isolation. Never replace an exact ordering by a universal epsilon comparator.
- Separate caller-side composition from actual Go imports. Independent scalar indicators are not wrappers around matrix or graph code. `core` and `matrix` are the foundational representations where needed.
- No future leakage, invented bars, holdout refits or unapproved model/approximation guarantees. A readiness mask, model fingerprint, config hash or snapshot is not evidence of source availability or authentication.
- One owner per mutable accumulator, stream and RNG. Error atomicity does not imply concurrent safety. Persist source/revision/cursor with compatible numeric state in an authenticated envelope. Keep calibration, model release, calendars, correction replay and decisions in the application.

## Package-specific cautions

### A. Topology, paths, capacity and discrete optimization

- [core contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/core/doc.go): Declare directed, weighted, loop, parallel and mixed-edge policy. Graph weights are finite; structural pointers may alias live records. An undirected edge retains its stored endpoints. Locking is not snapshot isolation.
- [builder contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/builder/doc.go): BuildGraph validates options and executes constructors in order; check setup errors, preserve seed and shape, and do not infer correctness from one generated family.
- [gridgraph contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/gridgraph/doc.go): Declare land threshold and neighborhood (4/8); distinguish minimum conversions from weighted route cost. Grid coordinates and graph IDs are separate representations.
- [bfs contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/bfs/doc.go): Visited means discovered/enqueued; Order means processed. Honor depth/filter/hooks and partial-result contracts; weak components are not SCCs. Weighted cost is not hop count.
- [dfs contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/dfs/doc.go): Order is finish, not discovery. A cycle witness is not exhaustive cycle enumeration. Require a DAG for topological order and respect partial-order validity.
- [dijkstra contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/dijkstra/doc.go): Keep unknown, unreachable (+Inf), disabled tracking and broken witnesses distinct. DistanceTo/ShortestPathTo run full SSSP; target PathResult retains original EdgeIDs. Validate finite nonnegative costs, heuristic consistency, exact target cutoff and walls.
- [mst contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/mst/doc.go): Strict MST never silently becomes MSF. Finite negative edges can be valid for MST, not KMB. SteinerResult network edges and WalkResult repeated passages have different objectives and costs; preserve original IDs.
- [flow contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/flow/doc.go): Finite capacity uses explicit epsilon policy; undirected edges become independent directed arcs, parallel arcs aggregate. Preserve residual/cut and Partial semantics; no input mutation or task orchestration.
- [matrix contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/matrix/doc.go): Preserve finite zero edges with explicit policy and +Inf absence; never export metric closure as original edges. View aliases; Clone detaches; read zero-element transform exceptions. FactorLU/QR/Cholesky are distinct from historical decompositions; SVD is not PCA or a solve. Respect rank, condition, residual, convergence and finite-domain diagnostics.
- [match contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/match/doc.go): Complete finite nonnegative approximately symmetric costs; no triangle inequality required. Preserve original index pairs, subset order and raw cost; never mutate TSP adjacency or silently fall back to Greedy.
- [tsp contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/tsp/doc.go): Tour cost is not shortest path or MST cost. Christofides 1.5 requires symmetric complete metric input and exact Blossom; Greedy does not certify it. Inspect incumbent, timeout, exactness and optimality separately.

### B. Time, features and alignment

- [series contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/series/doc.go): Keep sample indices, missing whole slots, timestamps and Valid masks separate; no interpolation or implicit resampling. Do not compress gaps into false adjacency.
- [acf contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/acf/doc.go): Fit one full-window mean or use explicit raw origin. LagAdjusted can exceed unit magnitude and lose Toeplitz PSD; no clipping, no causal prefix claim, FFT or significance test.
- [pacf contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/pacf/doc.go): Explicit full-window centering; preserve separate coefficient rows and reject nonpositive prediction variance, no epsilon repair. Not automatic AR fit or confidence bands.
- [paa contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/paa/doc.go): Every source observation contributes by overlap; no tail loss, padding or unweighted integer-bin shortcut. Returned averages/segments are detached.
- [sax contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/sax/doc.go): Right-bin equality and encoding-policy identity matter; compare compatible words only. MINDIST is not a certified DTW lower bound; identity digest is not authentication.
- [dtw contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/dtw/doc.go): Local cost, window, penalty, memory and path artifacts are explicit. Exact Search has its own certified LB_Keogh domain; neither generic DTW nor SAX MINDIST inherits that bound. DTW is not generally metric.
- [tfsax contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/tfsax/doc.go): No TFSAX codec or proven symbolic DTW pruning. Complete and Exact are independent; heuristic shortlist stays non-exact at observed recall 1. Preserve temporal provenance, strict-ID metrics and NA.

### C. Statistics, regression, hidden states and inference

- [stats contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/stats/doc.go): Exact represented-input mean and scaled second moments are distinct. Respect ddof, constant-column policy, transactional update/merge and train-only transforms; one owner per mutable accumulator.
- [ols contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/ols/doc.go): Explicit intercept or exact zero origin; rank/shape/condition diagnostics are not repaired by normal equations or pseudoinverse fallback. Fit preprocessing on training only.
- [ridge contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/ridge/doc.go): Penalty applies to optimization slopes, never intercept. Preserve physical predictions and explicit scaling, numerical rank and checked objective; no hidden Lambda=0 OLS mode.
- [pca contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/pca/doc.go): CovarianceEigen is implemented; ThinSVD remains unsupported on the reviewed contract. Verify spectrum/PSD/rank, compare degenerate subspaces, no holdout recentering/refit or automatic SVD fallback.
- [hmm contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/hmm/doc.go): Filter/FilterStep are causal; smoothing/decoding use full supplied sequence. Preserve zero-probability support, log-domain overflow distinction and independent training boundaries; ModelID is not source authentication.
- [lstm contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/lstm/doc.go): No training or prediction head. Keep gate/bias order, exact-zero masked output, unchanged masked state, ModelID-bound detached Hidden/Cell, numeric error instead of clipping. Check error before state reuse.

### D. Stochastic computation and econometrics

- [rng contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/rng/doc.go): One mutable stream per owner; immutable factory; preserve raw draw order, normal spare and version identity. Not cryptographic randomness.
- [bootstrap contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/bootstrap/doc.go): Returns indices, not statistics or confidence intervals. Preserve paired observations, unbiased bounded integers, per-replicate RNG identity, memory admission and complete-row interruption semantics.
- [montecarlo contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/montecarlo/doc.go): One stream per logical path, not worker; 2W scheduling bound, canonical reduction, byte admission; failed run exposes only contiguous complete prefix, no quantiles. Sampler owns model, payoffs and concurrency safety.
- [gbm contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/gbm/doc.go): Positive finite initial price, matching units, no implicit annualization; zero volatility consumes no entropy. Preserve safe log-growth publication and distinguish completed prefix from terminal success; no calibration or measure selection.
- [jumpdiffusion contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/jumpdiffusion/doc.go): Use arithmetic jump compensator expm1(m+s^2/2), not log mean; exact discrete bounded Poisson inversion/PTRS, no Gaussian count fallback. Intensity=0 delegates to GBM. Interrupted intervals are not terminal payoffs.
- [gjrgarch contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/gjrgarch/doc.go): Variance for r[t] is fixed before observing r[t]; negative shocks affect next variance. Respect stationarity and convergence diagnostics; unfinished fit is not an approved model; variance is not VaR.
- [arima contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/arima/doc.go): Condition on burn-in max(p,q) of differenced observations; strict Schur roots, no clipping or exact diffuse MLE claim. Preserve historical anchors; variance excludes parameter uncertainty.

### E. Indicators: readiness, arithmetic and recovery

- [ema contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/ema/doc.go): Finite signed values, 1<=P<MaxInt, no default; SMA ready at P-1, First at 0. Exact seed and RN64(((P-1)*prev+2*x)/(P+1)); P1 canonical +0. Keep bounded exact SeedSum; never substitute MACD's private kernel or rounded alpha.
- [atr contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/atr/doc.go): Validate finite low<=close<=high. TR0=RN64(H-L); later prior-close gaps. Seed P rounded TR values then RN64(((P-1)*prev+TR)/P); P1 identity. Positive periods, named default 14, Options{} invalid. TR never masked by ATR warmup.
- [donchian contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/donchian/doc.go): Include [i-P+1,i] ready P-1; exclude [i-P,i-1] ready P. Preserve latest equal extrema bits, one nearest-even midpoint, validate even masked/excluded rows. No default, Stream or Snapshot; MaxInt period legal. All failures nil; width arithmetic external.
- [vwap contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/vwap/doc.go): All finite signed prices, nonnegative finite weights, explicit first anchor. Reset before row; zero-weight prefix +0/false; later zero weight retains value/count. Exact weights 2^-1074 and products 2^-2148, one nearest-even ratio. No implicit HLC3, period or calendar.
- [sessionlevels contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/sessionlevels/doc.go): Compute canonical; ComputeDefault, ComputeDaily and ComputeWeekly delegate with Options{}. Explicit adjacent [Start,End) partition, only final incomplete; first masked +0/false, earliest equal extrema bits, exact last close. Any nil H/L/C fails; non-nil empty with no sessions succeeds. Context/nil/shape/manifest, global nonfinite before finite ErrBar; all failures nil. O(n+s) time/O(n) output/O(1) workspace; no calendar or stream/snapshot.
- [rsi contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/rsi/doc.go): Period counts changes, not candles; warmup mask is not an oscillator zero. Keep shared batch/stream recurrence and flat-price convention; reject invalid rows without state advance.
- [macd contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/macd/doc.go): Signal starts from ready Line, not warmup zeros; preserve signed outputs and distinct readiness. MACD's private recurrence is not ema's exact affine ABI. Keep batch/stream parity and snapshot identity.
- [mfi contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/mfi/doc.go): Preserve zero-volume slots and canonical typical-price arithmetic; reject invalid OHLCV; keep rolling ring and rebasing state in checkpoint. No fabricated first transition.
- [obv contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/obv/doc.go): First bar is valid zero regardless of its volume; compare successive closes and keep zero-volume continuity and Neumaier correction. No implicit session reset from time.
- [ad contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvlath/go/main/ad/doc.go): First bar contributes; flat candle contributes zero, no division by flat range or overflowing 2*Close. Keep Neumaier correction and source-bound replay distinct from OBV's seed.

## Detailed guides

### A. Topology, paths, capacity and discrete optimization

- [core guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/CORE.md): Deterministic capability-driven graph topology, stable IDs and traversal surfaces.
- [builder guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/builder/doc.go): Deterministic graph constructors and numeric datasets for experiments.
- [gridgraph guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/GRID_GRAPH.md): Rectangular lattice connectivity, island analysis, 0-1 expansion and conversion to core.Graph.
- [bfs guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/BFS.md): Unweighted shortest-hop traversal, deterministic paths and weak components.
- [dfs guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/DFS.md): Depth-first forest, finish order, cycle witnesses and topological sort.
- [dijkstra guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/DIJKSTRA.md): Full SSSP and four target methods: Dijkstra, bidirectional, consistent A*, balanced bidirectional A*.
- [mst guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/MST.md): Prim/Kruskal MST/MSF, KMB graph Steiner approximation, closed or fixed-end tree-covering walks.
- [flow guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/FLOW.md): Canonical MaxFlow (Dinic, Edmonds-Karp, Ford-Fulkerson) with MaxFlowResult residual, cut and interruption evidence.
- [matrix guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/MATRICES.md): Row-major dense algebra, graph adapters, APSP, stable statistics, pivoted solves and direct economy SVD.
- [match guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/MATCH.md): Minimum-weight perfect matching on an ordered even matrix subset; exact-or-error Blossom and explicit Greedy.
- [tsp guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/TSP.md): Matrix-backed TSP/ATSP, exact Held-Karp and completed Branch-and-Bound, Christofides and local search.

### B. Time, features and alignment

- [series guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/SERIES.md): Exact integer-nanosecond grids, causal lag/difference/returns, complete index windows.
- [acf guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/ACF.md): Direct fixed-window sample autocorrelation with common or lag-adjusted denominator and pair counts.
- [pacf guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/PACF.md): Common-n Durbin-Levinson partial autocorrelation and order-wise prediction-error variance.
- [paa guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/PAA.md): Fractional equal-duration compression with exact rational segment geometry and correctly rounded means.
- [sax guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/SAX.md): Immutable symbolic encoders over fractional PAA, explicit normalization and compatible Euclidean MINDIST.
- [dtw guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/DTW.md): Scalar, cost-matrix and multivariate alignment; bounded classifications and exact fixed-length squared-scalar top-K search.
- [tfsax guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/TFSAX.md): Research-only exact absolute-cost DTW oracle versus classical SAX TopM retrieval.
- [Exact DTW search](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/DTW_SEARCH.md): squared-cost certified top-K, budgets and partial results.

### C. Statistics, regression, hidden states and inference

- [stats guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/STATS.md): Stable scalar moments, Chan merges, immutable fitted column standardization.
- [ols guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/OLS.md): Full-rank least squares by column-pivoted QR, physical-unit coefficients and frozen prediction.
- [ridge guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/RIDGE.md): Positive-Lambda L2 regression via protected augmented pivoted QR, including wide/collinear designs.
- [pca guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/PCA.md): Immutable training covariance eigenbasis, projection and reconstruction in original units.
- [hmm guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/HMM.md): Categorical and diagonal-Gaussian hidden Markov models, filtering, smoothing, Viterbi and multi-sequence MAP-EM.
- [lstm guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/LSTM.md): Frozen single-layer unidirectional PyTorch IFGO recurrent inference over masked batch-first tensors.

### D. Stochastic computation and econometrics

- [rng guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/RNG.md): Version-pinned SHA-256/PCG-DXSM logical-path streams, open uniforms and cached normals.
- [bootstrap guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/BOOTSTRAP.md): Moving, Circular and Stationary dependent-data block-index ensembles.
- [montecarlo guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/MONTECARLO.md): Bounded-parallel independent vector sampling with ordered moments and optional exact empirical quantiles.
- [gbm guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/GBM.md): Exact-in-distribution lognormal endpoint paths on explicit elapsed-time grids.
- [jumpdiffusion guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/JUMPDIFFUSION.md): Experimental Merton compound-Poisson lognormal jumps on GBM grids.
- [gjrgarch guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/GJRGARCH.md): Stationary asymmetric GJR-GARCH(1,1), causal variance, expected-variance forecasts and Gaussian QMLE.
- [arima guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/ARIMA.md): Fixed nonseasonal conditional Gaussian ARIMA with anchored level forecasts and marginal innovation variance.

### E. Indicators: readiness, arithmetic and recovery

- [ema guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/EMA.md): Exact affine exponential levels with explicit SMA or First seed and recoverable streams.
- [atr guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/ATR.md): Exact signed-candle True Range and Wilder ATR with independent readiness and replay.
- [donchian guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/DONCHIAN.md): Observed rolling high/low channels with explicit current-bar policy and exact midpoint.
- [vwap guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/VWAP.md): Exact anchored price-volume means with positive-weight readiness and transactional reset.
- [sessionlevels guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/SESSIONLEVELS.md): explicit manifests, previous-session proof, readiness, error precedence, exact selection, correction replay and examples.
- [rsi guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/RSI.md): Wilder gain/loss oscillator over ordered finite positive prices, batch and checkpointable stream.
- [macd guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/MACD.md): SMA-seeded fast/slow Appel EMAs, signed Line/Signal/Histogram and separate masks.
- [mfi guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/MFI.md): Rolling volume-weighted typical-price flow over P transitions, compensated sums.
- [obv guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/OBV.md): Cumulative signed current-candle base volume with compensated accumulation.
- [ad guide](https://github.com/lvlath/go/blob/main/docs/AD.md): Chaikin close-location-weighted current-candle base volume with compensated accumulation.

## Numerical representations and alignment

- A (`core`, `builder`, `gridgraph`, `bfs`, `dfs`, `dijkstra`, `mst`, `flow`, `matrix`, `match`, `tsp`): topology and original IDs; finite edge costs vs dense absence; residual and path witnesses; dense factors and tour/matching objectives.
- B (`series`, `acf`, `pacf`, `paa`, `sax`, `dtw`, `tfsax`): sample indices, grid/gaps, fixed-window lag statistics, exact fractional geometry, compatible symbolic identity, time-alignment costs and research status. Euclidean MINDIST is not an exact DTW bound.
- C (`stats`, `ols`, `ridge`, `pca`, `hmm`, `lstm`): observation rows/feature columns, training-only coordinates, physical coefficients, covariance spectrum, stochastic transition/emission rows and batch-first recurrent tensor state. PCA ThinSVD is not implemented; HMM smoothing is noncausal; LSTM is inference only.
- D (`rng`, `bootstrap`, `montecarlo`, `gbm`, `jumpdiffusion`, `gjrgarch`, `arima`): logical path identity, index replicates, ordered moment reduction, explicit time units, positive path prefixes, causal return variance and anchored conditional mean. Sampling, calibration and execution are separate.
- E (`ema`, `atr`, `donchian`, `vwap`, `sessionlevels`, `rsi`, `macd`, `mfi`, `obv`, `ad`): aligned masks, finite-domain distinctions, explicit window/seed/origin and independent rounding laws. EMA/ATR exact seed and VWAP exact-sum continuation are different from MACD's private recurrence; Donchian and SessionLevels are batch-only. SessionLevels uses the preceding completed explicit interval, not a rolling window or VWAP reset; calendar and source availability stay external. Check each state ABI rather than sharing a generic checkpoint parser.

## Examples and verification

- [Runnable examples](https://github.com/lvlath/go/tree/main/examples): cross-package programs.
- [CI](https://github.com/lvlath/go/actions) and [coverage](https://codecov.io/github/lvlath/go): actual verification status; not a claim that a local change passed.
- Use the owning package directory for executable examples, independent tests and benchmarks. Do not assume a particular filename, standalone executable or latest published version. Run `go test ./...`, `go test -race ./...`, `go vet ./...` and the configured lint gate on the required toolchain; measure selected workloads with `-benchmem`. Read the owning coverage gate if applicable. Frozen inputs and external replay/serialization costs must be described honestly.
